```plato

    // The great-circle distance between two coordinates on a sphere of the given
    // radius, by the haversine formula — which, unlike the spherical law of
    // cosines, keeps its precision for the small distances a circular region
    // usually spans. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haversine_formula
    GreatCircleDistance(a: GeoCoordinate, b: GeoCoordinate, planetRadius: Length): Length {
        var lat1 = a.Latitude.Radians;
        var lat2 = b.Latitude.Radians;
        var halfDeltaLat = (lat2 - lat1) * 0.5;
        var halfDeltaLon = (b.Longitude.Radians - a.Longitude.Radians) * 0.5;
        var h = halfDeltaLat.Sin.Square
              + lat1.Cos * lat2.Cos * halfDeltaLon.Sin.Square;
        return new Length(2.0 * h.Sqrt.Min(1.0).AsinRadians * planetRadius.Meters);
    }
```
